recipe.name: Cutting Chai
steps: Rinse and lightly crush the ginger. Crack the cardamom pods so the seeds are exposed; keep the pods for brewing. Use a deep saucepan with room for the milk to rise.
Bring the water, ginger and cardamom to a boil. Simmer for 2 minutes, then add the tea leaves and boil gently for 2 minutes until the liquid is dark and aromatic.
Add the milk and sugar and stir until dissolved. Bring just to a rising boil, lower the heat immediately and simmer for 3–4 minutes, stirring so the milk does not catch.
When the chai is a rich brown and smells strongly of tea, strain through a fine sieve. Divide into four small heatproof glasses, about 100 ml each, and serve hot.
tips: Cutting means a small serving of strong chai; avoid prolonged boiling after the milk has reduced.
recipe.notes: Makes four small cutting glasses. Contains caffeine; ginger suitability follows your household choices.

recipe.name: Irani Chai
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the tea leaves, reduce to the lowest heat and cover with a normal loose-fitting lid; do not seal the pan airtight.
Simmer the tea gently for 20–25 minutes to make a dark concentrate. Check occasionally and lower the heat if it boils hard; it should retain roughly 300 ml of liquid.

Meanwhile simmer the milk in a separate heavy pan for 15–20 minutes, stirring and scraping the sides often, until reduced by about a quarter. Crumble in the mawa and whisk until no large lumps remain.
Stir the sugar into the thickened milk and heat for 2 minutes. Strain the tea concentrate, divide it between four cups and top with the sweet milk, stirring each cup before serving.
tips: Brew tea and milk separately: boiling mawa directly with tea leaves makes straining difficult.
recipe.notes: Four rich cafe-style cups; contains milk and caffeine. The tea and milk pans cook at the same time.

recipe.name: Elaichi Chai
steps: Crack the cardamom pods and lightly crush the seeds. Put both pods and seeds in a deep saucepan with the measured water.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes to release the cardamom aroma. Add the tea leaves and cook for another 2 minutes over medium-low heat.
Pour in the milk and add the sugar. Stir well, bring to a gentle rising boil and immediately lower the heat; simmer for 3 minutes until evenly caramel-coloured.
Switch off and strain into four warmed cups, discarding the tea leaves and pods. Serve promptly while the cardamom fragrance is fresh.
tips: Crush cardamom just before brewing; stored ground cardamom loses aroma quickly.
recipe.notes: Four regular cups of milk tea. Contains milk and caffeine.

recipe.name: Sulaimani Chai
steps: Lightly crush the cardamom pods and place them in a saucepan with the water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 2 minutes until lightly fragrant.
Switch off the heat, add the tea leaves and cover for 2 minutes. The brew should become clear amber rather than opaque and very dark.
Strain into a heatproof jug to stop extraction. Stir in the sugar until fully dissolved and allow the tea to stand for 1 minute off the heat.
Stir in the lemon juice only after straining; taste for a clean citrus finish. Divide between four glasses and serve hot without adding milk.
tips: Do not boil the tea leaves for a long time; this light tea is best with a short steep.
recipe.notes: Four cups of Malabar-style lemon black tea. Contains caffeine.

recipe.name: Noon Chai
steps: Put the tea leaves and cracked cardamom in a deep stainless-steel pan with 500 ml of the measured water. Reserve the remaining 300 ml water in the refrigerator until cold.
Bring to a boil and add exactly the measured baking soda. Simmer uncovered for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tea is concentrated and reddish-brown; do not let the pan dry out.
Add the reserved cold water. Keep the pan on low heat and repeatedly lift and pour the tea back with a ladle for 5 minutes, keeping the ladle close to the pan to avoid splashes.
Strain the concentrate into a clean pan, add the milk and salt, and simmer for 5–7 minutes. The colour should soften to dusty pink or pinkish tan; its shade depends on the tea leaves.
Slice the almonds finely. Divide the hot salted tea among four cups and scatter the almonds over each; serve without sugar for this savoury version.
tips: Use tea sold for noon chai. Do not add extra baking soda to force a brighter pink: it makes the tea unpleasantly alkaline.
recipe.notes: Four cups of traditional salted tea, not a sweet pink dessert drink. Contains milk, almonds and caffeine.

hi.Put the tea leaves and cracked cardamom: चाय पत्ती और फोड़ी इलायची को गहरे स्टील के पतीले में नापे पानी में से 500 मिली के साथ डालें। बाकी 300 मिली पानी फ्रिज में ठंडा होने रखें।

hi.Four cups of traditional salted tea, not: पारंपरिक नमकीन चाय के चार कप, मीठा गुलाबी पेय नहीं। दूध, बादाम और कैफीन युक्त।

gu.Four cups of traditional salted tea, not: પરંપરાગત ખારી ચાના ચાર કપ, મીઠું ગુલાબી પીણું નહીં. દૂધ, બદામ અને કેફીન ધરાવે છે.

recipe.name: Gur Chai
steps: Grate the jaggery and check for grit. Crush the washed ginger and crack the cardamom pods; reserve the jaggery until the tea has finished cooking.
Boil the water with ginger and cardamom for 2 minutes. Add the tea leaves and simmer for another 2 minutes until the brew is dark.
Add the milk, bring carefully to a gentle boil and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring. Turn off the heat and strain the tea into a heatproof jug.
Wait 2 minutes so the tea stops bubbling, then stir in the grated jaggery until dissolved. Divide among four cups and serve immediately; do not boil again after adding jaggery.
tips: Jaggery varies in acidity and can split milk if boiled together; add it after cooking and use fresh milk.
recipe.notes: Four cups sweetened with jaggery. Contains milk and caffeine; jaggery is still an added sweetener.

hi.Grate the jaggery and check for grit. Cr: गुड़ कद्दूकस करें और कंकड़ जाँच लें। धुला अदरक कूटें और इलायची फोड़ें; चाय पकने तक गुड़ अलग रखें।
hi.Boil the water with ginger and cardamom: पानी में अदरक और इलायची 2 मिनट उबालें। चाय पत्ती डालकर काढ़ा गहरा होने तक 2 मिनट और धीमा उबालें।
hi.Add the milk, bring carefully to a gentl: दूध डालें, सावधानी से हल्का उबाल आने दें और चलाते हुए 3 मिनट पकाएँ। आँच बंद करके गरमी सहने वाले जग में छानें।
hi.Wait 2 minutes so the tea stops bubbling: 2 मिनट रुकें ताकि चाय में बुलबुले बंद हो जाएँ, फिर कद्दूकस किया गुड़ घुलने तक मिलाएँ। चार कपों में तुरंत परोसें; गुड़ डालने के बाद दोबारा न उबालें।
hi.Jaggery varies in acidity and can split: गुड़ की अम्लता अलग-अलग होती है और साथ उबालने पर दूध फट सकता है; पकने के बाद डालें और ताजा दूध लें।
hi.Four cups sweetened with jaggery. Contai: गुड़ से मीठे चार कप। दूध और कैफीन युक्त; गुड़ भी अतिरिक्त मिठास है।

gu.Grate the jaggery and check for grit. Cr: ગોળ છીણો અને કાંકરી તપાસો. ધોયેલું આદુ કૂટો અને એલચી ફોડો; ચા તૈયાર થાય ત્યાં સુધી ગોળ અલગ રાખો.
gu.Boil the water with ginger and cardamom: પાણીમાં આદુ અને એલચી 2 મિનિટ ઉકાળો. ચાની પત્તી નાખી કાવો ઘેરો થાય ત્યાં સુધી વધુ 2 મિનિટ ધીમે ઉકાળો.
gu.Add the milk, bring carefully to a gentl: દૂધ નાખી સાવચેતીથી હળવો ઉકાળો લાવો અને હલાવતા 3 મિનિટ ઉકાળો. તાપ બંધ કરી ગરમી સહન કરતા જગમાં ગાળો.
gu.Wait 2 minutes so the tea stops bubbling: 2 મિનિટ રાહ જુઓ જેથી ચામાં પરપોટા બંધ થાય, પછી છીણેલો ગોળ ઓગળે ત્યાં સુધી હલાવો. ચાર કપમાં તરત પીરસો; ગોળ નાખ્યા પછી ફરી ન ઉકાળો.

gu.Four cups sweetened with jaggery. Contai: ગોળથી મીઠી કરેલી ચાના ચાર કપ. દૂધ અને કેફીન ધરાવે છે; ગોળ પણ ઉમેરેલી મીઠાશ છે.

recipe.name: Kesar Chai
steps: Warm 50 ml of the measured milk until just warm, not boiling. Lightly crumble the saffron into it and leave for 5 minutes while preparing the tea.
Crack the cardamom pods and boil with the water for 2 minutes. Add the tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes until amber-brown and fragrant.
Add the remaining milk and sugar. Bring to a gentle boil, lower the heat and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring to dissolve the sugar and prevent scorching.
Strain the tea into a jug, then stir in all the saffron milk and threads. Rest for 1 minute and divide into four cups so the saffron aroma is retained.
tips: This is a saffron-forward brew; do not keep boiling after the saffron milk is added.
recipe.notes: Four fragrant cups. Contains milk and caffeine; the saffron quantity is for the full four-serving batch.

hi.Warm 50 ml of the measured milk until ju: नापे दूध में से 50 मिली बस गुनगुना करें, उबालें नहीं। केसर हल्का मसलकर डालें और चाय तैयार करते समय 5 मिनट रहने दें।

hi.This is a saffron-forward brew; do not k: इस चाय में केसर का स्वाद प्रमुख है; केसर वाला दूध मिलाने के बाद उबालते न रहें।
hi.Four fragrant cups. Contains milk and ca: चार खुशबूदार कप। दूध और कैफीन युक्त; केसर की मात्रा पूरे चार कपों के लिए है।

gu.Warm 50 ml of the measured milk until ju: માપેલા દૂધમાંથી 50 મિલી માત્ર હૂંફાળું કરો, ઉકાળશો નહીં. કેસર હળવું મસળી નાખો અને ચા બનાવતાં 5 મિનિટ રહેવા દો.
gu.Crack the cardamom pods and boil with th: એલચી ફોડી પાણીમાં 2 મિનિટ ઉકાળો. ચાની પત્તી નાખી અંબર-ભૂરો રંગ અને સુગંધ આવે ત્યાં સુધી 2 મિનિટ ધીમે ઉકાળો.
gu.Add the remaining milk and sugar. Bring: બાકી દૂધ અને ખાંડ ઉમેરો. હળવો ઉકાળો આવે ત્યારે તાપ ધીમો કરી ખાંડ ઓગળે અને તળિયે ન ચોંટે તે માટે હલાવતા 3 મિનિટ ઉકાળો.
gu.Strain the tea into a jug, then stir in: ચા જગમાં ગાળો, પછી કેસરવાળું બધું દૂધ અને તાંતણા ઉમેરો. 1 મિનિટ રાખી ચાર કપમાં વહેંચો જેથી કેસરની સુગંધ જળવાય.
gu.This is a saffron-forward brew; do not k: આ ચામાં કેસરનો સ્વાદ મુખ્ય છે; કેસરવાળું દૂધ ઉમેર્યા પછી ઉકાળતા ન રહો.
gu.Four fragrant cups. Contains milk and ca: ચાર સુગંધિત કપ. દૂધ અને કેફીન ધરાવે છે; કેસરનું માપ આખા ચાર કપ માટે છે.

recipe.name: Tandoori Chai
steps: For the heated-clay finish, use only a food-safe kulhad explicitly rated by its maker for direct flame and thermal shock. Follow its heating instructions and use long tongs; if no suitable vessel is available, skip heating the clay and serve the brewed chai in ordinary food-safe kulhads.
Crush the ginger and cardamom. Boil them with the water for 3 minutes in a deep pan, add the tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes until dark and strongly aromatic.
Add milk and sugar, bring just to a rising boil and reduce the heat. Simmer for 4 minutes, stirring regularly, then strain the hot chai into a pouring jug.

Using tongs, set the correctly heated kulhad upright inside a large deep stainless-steel bowl on a heatproof surface, away from children. Stand back and pour a little hot chai into it slowly; expect vigorous frothing and let it subside before adding more.

Lift the kulhad with tongs and pour its tea into the collecting bowl. Repeat in small additions with the remaining chai, then serve in four separate cups. Discard the tea if the clay vessel chips or cracks; never serve from the heated vessel.
tips: Ordinary ceramic mugs and decorative terracotta are unsuitable for direct flame. The safe unheated-kulhad option will have less smoky flavour.
recipe.notes: Four cups. Contains milk and caffeine. The heated-clay finish requires purpose-made cookware and careful adult handling.

hi.For the heated-clay finish, use only a f: गरम मिट्टी वाले रूप के लिए केवल खाने योग्य ऐसा कुल्हड़ लें जिसे निर्माता ने सीधी आँच और अचानक ताप बदलने के लिए उपयुक्त बताया हो। उसके गरम करने के निर्देश मानें और लंबा चिमटा लें; उचित बर्तन न हो तो मिट्टी गरम करना छोड़ें और बनी चाय सामान्य खाद्य-सुरक्षित कुल्हड़ों में परोसें।
hi.Crush the ginger and cardamom. Boil them: अदरक और इलायची कूटें। गहरे पतीले में पानी के साथ 3 मिनट उबालें, चाय पत्ती डालें और गहरा रंग तथा तेज खुशबू आने तक 2 मिनट हल्का उबालें।
hi.Add milk and sugar, bring just to a risi: दूध और चीनी डालें, उफान आते ही आँच घटाएँ। नियमित चलाते हुए 4 मिनट हल्का उबालें, फिर गरम चाय डालने वाले जग में छानें।
hi.Using tongs, set the correctly heated ku: चिमटे से सही तरह गरम कुल्हड़ को बड़े गहरे स्टील के कटोरे में सीधा रखें। नीचे गरमी सहने वाली सतह हो और बच्चे दूर हों। पीछे रहकर थोड़ी गरम चाय धीरे डालें; तेज झाग उठेगा, और डालने से पहले उसे शांत होने दें।
hi.Lift the kulhad with tongs and pour its: चिमटे से कुल्हड़ उठाकर उसकी चाय नीचे वाले कटोरे में डालें। बची चाय थोड़ी-थोड़ी डालकर यही करें और चार अलग कपों में परोसें। मिट्टी का बर्तन चटके या टूटे तो चाय फेंक दें; गरम किए बर्तन में सीधे न परोसें।
hi.Ordinary ceramic mugs and decorative ter: सामान्य चीनी-मिट्टी के मग और सजावटी मिट्टी के बर्तन सीधी आँच के लिए ठीक नहीं हैं। सुरक्षित बिना गरम कुल्हड़ वाले विकल्प में धुएँ जैसा स्वाद कम होगा।

recipe.name: Lemongrass Tea
steps: Rinse the lemongrass thoroughly. Snip the leaves into short lengths and gently bruise any tender stalk pieces with the back of a knife to release their lemony scent.
Bring the water and lemongrass to a boil in a deep saucepan. Simmer for 3 minutes until fragrant, then add the tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour in the milk and stir in the sugar. Bring just to the boil, reduce the heat and cook for 3 minutes, watching closely to prevent the milk from boiling over.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove every fibrous leaf and stalk. Divide into four cups and serve hot while the fresh citrus aroma is strongest.
tips: Use culinary lemongrass, not lawn grass; strain carefully because the leaves remain fibrous after brewing.
recipe.notes: Four cups of Maharashtrian gavti chaha. Contains milk and caffeine.

recipe.name: Pudina Chai
steps: Pick the mint leaves from any tough stems and rinse them in several changes of water. Drain well and lightly tear the leaves just before using.
Bring the water to a boil, add the tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes. Add half the mint and cook for another 1 minute so its aroma enters the brew.
Add the milk and sugar and stir. Bring to a gentle boil, lower the heat and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent a skin forming at the bottom.
Switch off, add the remaining mint and cover for 1 minute. Strain immediately into four cups; the tea should smell fresh and minty rather than taste like overcooked greens.
tips: Adding some mint after switching off preserves its fragrance; do not leave the leaves sitting in the finished tea.
recipe.notes: Four cups of fresh mint milk tea. Contains milk and caffeine.
